game.core.world.secret.summary: The alcove holds an old binding ward tied to a pact struck generations ago with a dragon that once guarded this river crossing before any bridge existed. The ward is failing, slowly. The new toll order exists because someone in the crown found out and wants the site quietly monitored without causing public panic ahead of the succession. This is a slow-burn campaign-arc thread, not meant to resolve in one session -- no fixed reward or XP yet; the GM should let its shape emerge through play rather than solving it early.
